test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the Census of 2011, which of the following has the second highest literacy rate in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Lakshadweep.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Census 2011**, Lakshadweep, with a literacy rate of **91.8**%, is the Union Territory with the highest literacy rate in India.**
 
• **And according to the Census of 2011 Lakshadweep has the second-highest literacy rate in India.**

 
• Kerala ranks the highest in terms of literacy rate with a 94.00% literacy rate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• As per the 2011 census, the literacy rate of India is 74.04 %.

 
 
• Male literacy rate = 82.14%.
 
• Female literacy rate = 65.46%.
 
 
 
• The top five** states and UTs **where the literacy rate is the highest are:
 
 
• Kerala (94%)
 
• Lakshadweep (91.8%)
 
• Mizoram (91.3%)
 
• Goa (88.7%)
 
• Tripura (87.2%).
 
 
 
• Among the State/UTs, the male and female literacy rate is highest in Kerala (male: 96.11%, female 92.07%) and lowest in Bihar (male: 71.2%, female: 51.5%).
